thread:
Jamal: Hey team — Helios Health (opp #HL-0923) is asking for our SOC 2 Type II report before the POC kickoff. Customer says legal won't sign a full NDA yet. Can we offer an evidence-escrow path or a scoped extract instead of the full report?

Priya: short version: they need something to show controls for security team sign-off. POC timeline is tight (starts next Monday). Any quick standard options?

Lena: We can't give the full unredacted report publicly. Options we normally use: 1) presigned S3 object to an NDA-signee or an email allowlist for 72h, 2) scoped extract (limited controls pages + redaction) with a one-page attestation, or 3) formal escrow transfer under a bridge/escrow agreement.

Jamal: are (1) or (2) doable without Legal board sign-off? Customer is pushing for something we can hand over today.

Marco: We can do a presigned link to a staging bucket for a short window without a signed NDA if we use our "interim-attestation" template and require a short acknowledgement (email + click-through). But note: that is higher risk. If customer insists on unredacted report we need an NDA or a signed escrow/bridge letter.

Lena: +1 Marco. For presigned links we require: customer org email list, IP allowlist if available, expiry <= 72h, and write-disabled ACL. Also we log access and require recipient to confirm deletion after download.

Priya: what's the exact aws cli presign command ops would run? I can pass to Helios.

ops-bot: Example presign (internal template):
```
aws s3 presign s3://redwood-soc2-staging/hel-2025-soc2.pdf --expires-in 259200 --region us-west-2
```
(we canonicalize to 72h = 259200s; ops will set ACL and bucket policy before sharing)

Marco: If we go with scoped extract + attestation we need Legal to craft a 1-paragraph attestation and a redaction log. That usually takes ~1 business day.

Jamal: Customer asked about an "escrow" vendor — they offered to accept a copy via a third-party escrow. Any policy on third-party escrow deliveries?

Lena: We allow third-party escrow only if Legal pre-approves the vendor and we have a transfer agreement. That path will be longer (3-5 business days). Not good for POC start next week.

Priya: Ok — proposed plan: presigned 72h link + our interim-attestation doc + requirement for customer to acknowledge in email (to Marco). If Helios pushes back we offer scoped extract but that's next-day. Jamal, can you confirm customer email list now?

Jamal: Sending contact: security@helioshealth.com and vendorsec@helioshealth.com. I'll add required fields to the SF record.

Marco: I'll draft the interim-attestation and a short email template for acknowledgement. Once Jamal posts the customer emails here I'll send the presign request to eng-ops.

Lena: I'll double-check the redaction rules for the extract in case they want that fallback.

ops-bot: Noted. Ticket created: OPS-4972 — prepare presigned link and enforce ACL/logging. ETA: 4 hours.

Priya: :thumbsup: If we can get that link + attestation today we should be fine for kickoff. Jamal — please loop me on the customer thread so I can coordinate technical handoff.

Jamal: Will do. Thanks all.

Marco: Drafted interim-attestation (short): "Redwood Inference confirms this document is an interim copy of our SOC 2 Type II report provided for the limited purpose of vendor risk review for Helios Health. It is provided under Redwood's interim access policy and is subject to access restrictions. It is not a waiver of any contractual requirements for a full report under NDA or escrow." Pasting into Helios email is fine.

Priya: Perfect. Jamal — send that and cc @Lena so we can track any redaction asks.

Jamal: Sending now. I'll update OPS-4972 with the presign link when it lands.

Lena: FYI for records — file SOC2-access-Helios in our evidence tracker once they confirm download.

Jamal: Confirmed download will be requested. Closing loop after POC kickoff.

ops-bot: OPS-4972 updated: presign link created and expires in 72h. Link sent to security@helioshealth.com.
